title: State Commission or National Commission must record reasons for delayed disposal
description: The Commission must record reasons for disposing of appeal after 90 days

content.what: must record reasons for delayed disposal
conditions: appeal is disposed of after 90 days
limitations: no adjournment shall ordinarily be granted unless sufficient cause is shown
reasons for grant of adjournment must be recorded in writing
costs occasioned by the adjournment shall be specified by regulations
